external_egg_termination.interpretation: External Slurm wall-time termination during supported initialization. No natural producer closure, final contact equilibrium or stage acceptance. Existing snapshots/logs preserved exactly; this record does not substitute producer closure.

refinement.scope: Audit resolved-contact mesh changes and reference-only gauge/cache candidates.
refinement.limitations: Two useful contact levels do not establish a tail. Body geometry and pad spatial discretization change together; separate axes, contact regularization, nonlinear pad compliance and full egg/Franka comparisons remain required. Cache and centre fixing are reference-only changes under exactly zero total x force. No wall-time speedup is inferred from factor reuse counts.

summary.excluded_physical_observations: Earlier unguarded/repeated traction captures, rejected body-source-prior loads and original figure failures remain exact but are not physical acceptance evidence.

limitations: Two useful resolved-U levels have large tensor/energy changes and up to7.5% pad strain. Original force/moment inputs, local traction and full native fields are audited in guarded replay. Near-zero aggregate body-prior rejection/acceptance at FP64 cancellation scale and original observer/figure failures remain visible. Egg wall-time termination has external metadata only, not fabricated producer closure. Third-level/separated-axis/egg retries are live and excluded. Nonlinear pads, contact regularization/history tails, actual Franka matching, rigid feedback and physically qualified accuracy/cost remain required. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
